text.p: Schering Corp, a unit of Schering-Plough Corp, said Friday it had exercised an option to buy 250,000 Series B convertible preferred shares of Corvas International Inc.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Schering said it bought the shares for $2.0 million on December 23.
Schering previously held 1.0 million Series A convertible preferred shares that it bought under a 1994 purchase agreement for $5.0 million.
Schering, a Kenilworth, N.J.,-based maker of prescription drugs sold in the U.S., said it now holds the equivalent of an 8.4 percent stake in Corvas, or 1.25 million common shares.
Corvas is a San Diego, Calif.,-based biopharmaceutical company.
